response.text: Payment 81's one-cent difference is a real settlement inconsistency, but the instructions say to report only demonstrable problems, and this one is demonstrable. I'll include it as "other".

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" or h."POST_DT">p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT")
findings.summary: Journals 2469 (period 1, POST_DT 20240222) and 2470 (period 2, POST_DT 20240326) were posted after their closed periods' end dates and CLOSE_DT; POST_DT lies outside the period they are assigned to.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", s.dr, s.cr from "APINVH" i join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO") s on s."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where s.dr<>i."INV_AMT" or s.cr<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 733 has INV_AMT 22404.56 but its recording journal 2206 posts 22440.56 (Dr expense / Cr AP), a 36.00 difference (digit transposition).

findings.evidence_sql: select a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID" dup_id, a."VEND_CD", a."INV_NO", b."INV_NO", a."INV_AMT", b."INV_AMT" from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and trim(a."VEND_CD")=trim(b."VEND_CD") and regexp_replace(lower(a."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(b."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
findings.summary: Invoices 801 and 802 duplicate invoices 690 and 324 (same vendor, same invoice number differing only by leading spaces, same amount and date); the duplicates are open and unpaid while the originals are paid.

findings.evidence_sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Payment 81 pays 8180.75 against invoice 126 of 8180.76 (one cent short) yet the invoice is marked paid; the only payment differing from its invoice amount.
